definitions.n: Number of probe captures. The reference is excluded.
definitions.accepted: Inspection difference below hold, or a seal result of INTACT.
definitions.flagged: Inspection difference at or above hold, or a seal result of SUSPICIOUS.
definitions.unverifiable: No decision due to capture quality, registration, or ambiguous seal similarity.
definitions.not_evaluated: Comparison skipped because the reference could not be admitted. Any standalone assessment applies only to the individual image.
definitions.false_accepts: Accepted probes labelled defect, blurry, glare, misaligned, torn, repositioned, or bad_light.
definitions.false_rejects: Flagged probes labelled good or intact_recapture. Unverifiable probes are counted separately.

input_metadata_definition: Byte lengths and JPEG frame boundaries are read directly from the original files. JPEG trailing bytes are counted after the primary image's structural end-of-image marker. Declared width and height are read from the image header without decoding pixels or applying orientation.

comparison_states.SCORED: A comparison produced a numeric score and an accepted or flagged outcome.
comparison_states.AMBIGUOUS: The seal API returned UNVERIFIABLE with a measured similarity.
comparison_states.FAILED: An input, quality, or registration failure left the score unavailable.
comparison_states.SKIPPED: The reference was unusable and the probe comparison did not run.

performance_definition: Coverage uses all probe captures as the denominator. Error rates use attempted probes from the corresponding negative or positive labels. UNVERIFIABLE is counted separately from false rejects. Score ranges include only comparisons with numeric scores.

threshold_choice.selection: The evaluator applies the default thresholds and supplied overrides before comparing probes.
